MARVIN MANDEL
MARYLAND

301 WEST PRESTON STREET
BALTIMORE, MARYLAND 21201
TELEPHONE: 301-383-2451
VLADIMIR A. WAHBE SECRETARY OF STATE PLANS NORMAN HEBDEN DEPUTY SECRETARY
April 3, 1972
Director.

Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
U. S. Department of the Interior
Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Sir:
Pursuant to the requirements of Section 102 (2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, the Maryland State Clearinghouse has reviewed the draft environmental statement on H.R. 1311, proposed "Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972."
The State of Maryland concurs with the intent of this proposed legislation and feels that any short-term detrimental impact will be more than compensated by the protection and eventual restoration of endangered and threatened species.
We appreciate the opportunity to review and comment on this proposal.
Sincerely yours,
Vladimir Wahbe
